 2 weather alerts in effect Listeria concerns prompt Family Farmstead Dairy cheddar cheese recall 
 RELATED VIDEO: Contaminated food is causing more illnesses in the U.S., according to a report from the Public Interest Research Group. (Source: Canva, DCC Gray News) By CNN Newsource Published : Nov. 12, 2026 at 1:14 PM EST | Updated : 3 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google (CNN) - Family Farmstead Dairy has recalled its raw mild and raw sharp cheddar .
 The affected products were sold in eight-ounce packages and have expiration dates of Oct. 16, 2027, or before.
 Family Farmstead Dairy has recalled its raw mild and raw sharp cheddar. (FDA) The affected cheese was sold in stores in Connecticut, Delaware, Massachusetts, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, Tennessee, Virginia, Vermont and West Virginia.
 No other Family Farmstead Dairy products are affected by this recall.
 Customers are asked to return the recalled cheese to the store where it was bought or contact Family Farmstead Dairy directly for further help.
